description_en: Queries the global configuration of vulnerability scanning for the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号的漏洞扫描全局配置
name: GetVulScanGlobalConfig

MaxDownloadSpeed.description_en: The maximum download speed for vulnerability patches on a single user terminal device. Unit: bytes per second. A value of 0 indicates no speed limit
MaxDownloadSpeed.description_zh: 单个用户终端设备下载漏洞补丁的速率上限。单位为Byte/s。取值为0表示不限速

WuyingVulFixConfig.description_en: The vulnerability fix configuration for WUYING Workspace. This configuration takes effect only on user terminal devices of the Cloud Desktop type
WuyingVulFixConfig.description_zh: 无影云桌面的漏洞修复配置。仅对无影云桌面类型的用户终端设备生效

AntiShutdownSwitch.description_en:
Specifies whether to prohibit shutdown during the fix process to prevent system exceptions caused by shutting down during patch installation. Valid values:
true: Shutdown is prohibited.
false: Shutdown is not prohibited
AntiShutdownSwitch.description_zh:
修复期间是否禁止关机，用于避免补丁安装过程中因关机导致系统异常。取值：
true：禁止关机。
false：不禁止关机

SnapshotSwitch.description_en:
Specifies whether to create a snapshot for the cloud desktop before the fix, which can be used for rollback if the fix fails. Valid values:
true: A snapshot is created.
false: No snapshot is created
SnapshotSwitch.description_zh:
修复前是否为云桌面创建快照，用于修复失败后回滚。取值：
true：创建快照。
false：不创建快照
